      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan covering a period of not less than 1 fiscal year and not more than 2 fiscal years, submitted not later than 30 days prior to the beginning of the first fiscal year covered by the plan, containing such information as the Secretary shall require, including: (1) an assurance that funds made available through the grant or allotment will be used (A) to support activities designed to assist low-income families and individuals (including those receiving TANF under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act, homeless persons, migrant or seasonal farmworkers, and elderly low-income persons) and a description of how such activities will enable them to remove obstacles/solve problems blocking self-sufficiency, secure and retain employment, attain an adequate education (including literacy/family literacy initiatives), make better use of available income, obtain and maintain adequate housing and suitable living environment, obtain emergency assistance, and achieve greater participation in community affairs (including grassroots partnerships to document best practices and strengthen relationships with law enforcement), (B) to address needs of youth in low-income communities through youth development programs, and (C) to make more effective use of and coordinate with other related programs; (2) a description of how the State intends to use discretionary funds from the remainder described in section 9907(b); (3) information from eligible entities describing service delivery systems, linkages, coordination with other resources, and support of innovative initiatives; (4) an assurance of emergency provision of supplies, services, and nutritious food to counteract starvation and malnutrition; (5) an assurance of coordination/linkages between governmental and social service programs, and a description of coordinating employment and training activities under the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act; (6) an assurance of coordination between antipoverty programs and low-income home energy assistance (title XXVI); (7) an assurance to permit and cooperate with Federal investigations under section 9916; (8) an assurance that any eligible entity funded in the previous fiscal year will not have funding terminated or reduced below its proportional share unless after notice and hearing on the record the State determines cause exists, subject to Secretary review under section 9915(b); (9) an assurance to coordinate and form partnerships with other organizations serving low-income residents; (10) an assurance to require each eligible entity to establish petition procedures regarding board representation; (11) an assurance to secure a community action plan including a community-needs assessment from each eligible entity; (12) an assurance that the State and eligible entities will participate by fiscal year 2001 in ROMA or an alternative performance measurement system under section 9917(b), with descriptions of outcome measures; and (13) information describing how the State will carry out the assurances in this subsection.",
